text.description_html:
Adams Rite 2331, Heavy Duty Deadbolt for Sliding Doors

The Adams Rite 2331 door lock is for use on wood or metal sliding doors. This Heavy Duty Sliding Door Deadbolt operates by the use of a key or thumbturn which throws the deadbolt. Once thrown, the brass bolt sends out two stainless steel dogs to secure the door. The Heavy Duty Deadbolt for Sliding Doors can be paired with most standard mortise cylinders (standard cams) or with a standard mortise cylinder thumbturn.

This Sliding Door Heavy Duty Deadbolt requires the use of a mortise cylinder or with mortise cylinder thumbturn (not included) to operate the bolt.

Features and Specifications of the Sliding door Lock:

  • Face Plate Height: 5-3/4"
  • Face Plate Width: 1"
  • Case: Zinc alloy, measures 7/8” x 3-5/8” x 2-5/8” deep.
  • Bolt: Brass with stainless steel dogs, 1/2” x 1-1/2” with 3/4” horizontal throw and 11/32” expansion above and below main bolt.
  • Strike: 1/8” x 1” x 4-11/16” with 5/8” x 1-5/8” opening.
  • Backset: 1-3/4”
  • Armored Faceplate
  • Adams Rite 2331 Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually
